meta.summary: AI spend envelopes set at 2.0x sector median for a 300-person scaling software company with team-level variance bands and agent kill switches.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are reimbursable up to $50/month per employee only when no approved equivalent exists on the allowlist and the purchase is submitted with a project tag within 30 days.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn exceeds 90% before month end or single-hour agent spend exceeds $60
Team envelope burn exceeds 105% of monthly allocation or agent retry count exceeds 50 per task
Company envelope burn exceeds 115% of monthly allocation or agent hourly spend exceeds $80

rationales.e1: Support team production inference at $211/day runs within the $5,000 monthly Support envelope and is correctly classified as COGS under the production-inference project tag rule.
rationales.e2: Data team nightly embeddings at $38/day annualizes to roughly $1,140/month, well inside the $8,000 Data envelope, and passes without escalation.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 60% variance band on the Engineering envelope and triggering a step-1 alert to the Engineering team lead for root-cause review of the deploy.
rationales.e4: Subscription 3 for Marketing against a 5 subscription threshold. Approved.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate 4800 against the 10000 approval line. Approved.
rationales.e6: 340 retries at 47 per hour, over the 50 retry limit. About 1090 in overnight burn prevented. Blocked, owner paged.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is self-serve eligible under the 168-hour window and the incremental cost is within the $1,200 delta cap, so it is approved without escalation.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer's personal API key at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers a step-2 throttle under the Engineering lead, with a 12-hour window to supply a valid project tag before the key is suspended.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent's $499 dataset license purchase falls within the $600 single-transaction ceiling and the dataset-license merchant scope on the agent card, so it is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team's $89/month AI video trial duplicates the Sales team's $1,400/year contract running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider charged 120; the new-provider rule is set to allow_with_review. Approved.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to an internal tool is reclassified from COGS to OpEx under the internal-tool project tag rule; no approval is required and the correction is logged for the month-end close.
rationales.e13: Company spend at 87% of envelope against a 90% burn alert, 9 days left. Approved.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup is clean: one agent loop terminated, one provider review queued, one classification corrected, and all team envelopes within authorized bands.
